description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from US-PL-111-260 Sec. 101, new Communications Act Sec. 3(1): 'advanced communications services' means (A) interconnected VoIP service; (B) non-interconnected VoIP service; (C) electronic messaging service; and (D) interoperable video conferencing service.
title: CVAA advanced communications service
